purpose: Remove researcher discretion from candidate ordering and separate discovery, eligibility adjudication, enrollment, semantic authoring, and RISU verdict observation.

stage_separation.name: DISCOVERY_POOL_FREEZE
allowed_information: whether the artifact plausibly exposes an API or tool projection
prohibited_information: known consequence-regression issue or bug status used as a selection rationale
detailed target implementation path chosen because it appears to omit a guard
stage_separation.freeze_rule: The candidate pool is committed before detailed eligibility screening.

stage_separation.name: DETERMINISTIC_ORDER
stage_separation.rule: No manual reordering after the candidate pool is frozen.

stage_separation.name: ELIGIBILITY_SCREENING
allowed_information: public reproducible evidence needed to apply the protocol inclusion and exclusion rules
organization, stratum, and carrier family needed for diversity constraints
prohibited_information: running RISU Verify on the candidate
observing a RISU C/D/O or Exact result
searching issue trackers for a known target bug before the enrollment decision
stage_separation.decision: ELIGIBLE or REJECTED with one or more protocol-grounded reasons
stage_separation.log_rule: Every screened candidate is appended to SCREENING_LOG.jsonl in deterministic order.

stage_separation.name: CONSTRAINT_AWARE_ENROLLMENT
stage_separation.rule: Take eligible candidates in deterministic order unless enrollment would violate the hard per-organization cap. Diversity gates are completion constraints, not result quotas. If the frozen pool cannot satisfy them without outcome-driven substitution, report INSUFFICIENT_DIVERSITY and freeze the failure rather than changing the procedure.

stage_separation.name: POST_ENROLLMENT_AUTHORING
stage_separation.rule: Only after enrollment may the detailed semantic instance, evidence envelope, adapter, and friction ledger be completed. AI or heuristics may propose authoring material but may not establish evidence facts or issue a verdict. Human acceptance is required before verifier execution.

stage_separation.name: VERDICT_OBSERVATION
stage_separation.rule: RISU Verify runs only after the unit is enrolled and its authoring freeze is committed. PRESERVED, PRESERVED_IN_DECLARED_SCOPE, CONSEQUENCE_REGRESSION, INCOMPLETE_ASSURANCE, integrity failures, and null findings are all retained.

discovery_design.preferred_organization_diversity: At least 8 organizations in the frozen discovery pool when feasible.
discovery_design.metadata_only_discovery_rule: Discovery may use broad repository/package search and README-level metadata. Detailed operation implementation inspection belongs to eligibility screening after the pool freeze.

change_control: Do not edit this procedure in place after candidate discovery begins. Any change requires a numbered procedure amendment stating whether pool freeze, screening, enrollment, authoring, or verdict observation had begun.
